text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: This state of affairs... is practically a nightmare.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Nay, the very moment one starts calling it a dream, it becomes far too fragile and shallow...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: So that is how I appear to you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
You're right, rushing won't bring results...
First, I must accept my own mediocrity and immaturity.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...With that in mind, I want to consider the path leading to the throne.
Will you cooperate with me, Trainer?"

I had a thorough discussion with Symboli Rudolf
regarding our path forward.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
You—still believe in me.
Even after seeing me in such a pathetic state.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's right... This isn't my limit.
There's no way this could be my limit!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Above all else, I will never allow it!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Symboli Rudolf's glory begins right here...!
